Previous lessons:
Helpful changes: Adoption photo and style tools (photo quality hints, style selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact photo grids), sign-in session safeguard hints and retrieval flows, clear desktop control hints/copy, compact welcome dashboards, and waiting readiness hints/carousels.
Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns, banners, and taskbar guidance copy, pre-adoption photo prep screens, pre/post-certificate sign-in stage shifts, path speed helper callouts, story scroll intros, and instant activation incentives.
No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, adoption certificate incentive badges, account persistence verification flows, two-column or carousel path layouts, and most waiting progress checklists.

lessons: Helpful changes: Adoption photo and style tools (pre-upload inspection, style selectors, compact grids), sign-in safeguard hints and retrieval flows, desktop control copy/hints, compact welcome dashboards, and waiting progress carousels.

Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and taskbar guidance copy, pre-adoption photo prep screens, pre/post-certificate sign-in stage shifts, story scroll intros, and instant activation incentives.
No clear effect seen: Audio notifications, adoption certificate incentive badges, account persistence verification flows, and most waiting progress checklists.

Predictions were too low: Gains were underestimated for clear desktop control copy, tray visibility hints, compact welcome dashboards, pre-upload style inspection, path reassurance hints, and session safeguard hints.

Predictions were too high: Gains were overestimated for desktop finish redesigns, preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in stage shifts, split-view story intros, instant activation incentives, and all tests with negative performance.
